source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical getContexts test first waited for about:addons through a new tab helper, then separately waited for the extension options-loaded message before checking its TAB context. The accepted later test avoids pre-opening the manager because its comment reports overlapping initial and options loads. It also includes the options documentId. The helper closes only after a successful callback, so it is not evidence of cleanup on rejection. The URL assertion alone does not prove focus. No test ran.
title: A loaded about:addons page is separate from a loaded extension options context
